    if not all((isinstance(n, BioCypherEdge) for n in edge_list)):
        logger.error('Edges must be passed as type BioCypherEdge.')
        return False
    lines = []
    for e in edge_list:
        eprops = e.get_properties()
        hprops = list(prop_dict.keys())
        keys = list(eprops.keys())
        if not keys == hprops:
            oedge = f'{e.get_source_id()}-{e.get_target_id()}'
            oprop1 = set(hprops).difference(keys)
            oprop2 = set(keys).difference(hprops)
            logger.error(f'At least one edge of the class {e.get_label()}                 has more or fewer properties than the others.                 Offending edge: {oedge!r}, offending property:                 {max([oprop1, oprop2])}.')
            return False
        if hprops:
            plist = []
            for (ev, tv) in zip(eprops.values(), prop_dict.values()):
                if tv == int:
                    plist.append(str(ev))
                else:
                    plist.append(self.quote + str(ev) + self.quote)
            lines.append(self.delim.join([e.get_source_id(), self.delim.join(plist), e.get_target_id(), e.get_label()]) + '\n')

import platform
import time
import ctypes
import os

class timespec(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('tv_sec', ctypes.c_long), ('tv_nsec', ctypes.c_long)]
libc = ctypes.CDLL('libc.dylib')

def clock_gettime(clk_id):
    if platform.system().lower() == 'darwin':
        seconds = time.perf_counter()
        return seconds
    else:
        t = timespec()
        if libc.clock_gettime(clk_id, ctypes.pointer(t)) != 0:
            errno_ = ctypes.get_errno()

        self.version = status.version
    cke = ClientKeyExchange(status.cipher, self.version)
    premaster_secret = self.premaster_secret
    assert len(premaster_secret) > 1
    premaster_secret[0] = self.version[0]
    premaster_secret[1] = self.version[1]
    server_cert = status.server_cert
    public_key = server_cert.get_public_key()
    encrypted_secret = public_key.encrypt(premaster_secret)
    cke.createRSA(encrypted_secret)
    return cke
